artifacts.summary: Seven-phase plan across four waves covering Parts A, B, C and C2: retarget --revise/--learn onto hosted knowledge objects, delete the six hosted-store-redundant sub-modes with a surgical scoring-engine prune, remove the two orphaned core callers and the archive-time harvest, and close the tagged-write half of the sapience retrieval loop via instruction-level shape (a).

memory_candidates.content: When retargeting a consumer that enumerates a local store onto a hosted store that offers only a capped keyword query (no enumeration endpoint), invert the correlation direction rather than adding an enumeration read path: instead of 'enumerate every stored item, then correlate evidence onto it', do 'cluster the evidence first, apply the recurrence threshold, then query the store once per surviving cluster'. This preserves every classification outcome, needs no new read surface, and is strictly cheaper because only clusters past the threshold are queried. Mandatory companion: if the query path returns the same signal (non-zero exit, empty stdout) for both a zero-hit result and a transport failure, the consumer must open with a reachability probe against a known-present item, or a network failure silently reclassifies every cluster as a gap.
